lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately parallel horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin base; the primary constellation consists of 4-5 visible vertical columns of nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical linear features of higher luminance intersecting the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid-like structure of anchor nodes in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature in the upper dorsal region characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition, with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.
